language_lanes.note: Marketing Fesztivál prints 2027-01-28, Lurdy, Budapest and names a co-located Mesterséges Intelligencia Fesztivál; stored with relevance other. ICPL 2027 (May 7-8) is a linguistics conference and out of theme; AI Summit 2027 and Craft 2027 are already stored; AI Talks 2026 is past.
Results are 2025-26 news, course and newsletter pages (NJSZT, Edutus, fintechzone); none prints a 2027 Budapest dated occurrence.
Generic conference aggregators plus an ELTE learning/knowledge conference (Feb 2027, not data science); no organiser page printing a 2027 Budapest data-science date.

Meetup group calendar and dev.events listing pages; no dated 2027 Budapest Web3 event printed on an organiser page. Craft 2027 and The Budapest Exchange 2027 are already stored and are not Web3 events.
MoneroKon 2027 is 9-11 July 2027 in Krakow, Poland, so it is out of city; the GitHub planning issue that named Budapest (25-27 June) is stale. Portfolio Investment Day 2027 is already stored.

ICBC 2027 (WASET) prints two different date pairs on the organiser's own pages (Aug 23-24 and Oct 11-12), so it is dropped as unreliable; WCCBDIG (1 Feb 2027) is an aggregator listing with no Budapest venue; SZMT Konferencia 2027 is an unrelated organisational-development event.

Budapest Data+AI Forum 2027 (already stored, ML/AI) heads the results; MODELS 2027 (26 Sep-1 Oct, Danubius Hotel Helia) is a model-driven-engineering conference with AI topics, and MANUF2027 is a manufacturing conference, so neither is retained. ICAIDLML 2027 is a conference-alert listing with no venue.
Budapest Data+AI Forum 2027 and DevFest Budapest 2027 are already stored; WASET ICDAAIE and ICDMBDDDS list Budapest dates but publish no venue and two dates per title, so no new record.
Conference directories (ConferenceGrid, dev.events) and The Budapest Exchange 2027 (already stored, transport/ticketing, not Web3); no dated 2027 Budapest Web3 conference on an organiser page.
WASET ICBC (conflicting dates), conferenceindex aggregator and a blog list; no organiser page printing a 2027 Budapest crypto event at a venue.

method: Cell = theme x lane. pages_read is the number of lane URLs actually read in this run (one shared capture serves every theme in the lane; it is not multiplied). theme_term_hits counts capture lines that carry the theme term in English or Hungarian; example_lines quotes up to two. retained_yield credits a stored event once, in the lane whose capture prints its 2027 date. Dispositions: opened_yield / opened_empty / partial_aliases_404 / payload_limited_js_shell / opened_directory_no_2027_date.
notes: 31 lane URLs were read for the six themes (54 cells); the same capture serves every theme in its lane, so the pages-read total is 31, not 54.

MiraGather main, ?tab=side and /ai return a six-line JavaScript shell (64-99 bytes of text) with no event payload; AI Tinkerers all_cities is a 281-city directory and the Budapest chapter page prints '1 recent event' with no 2027 date.

The ten language lanes above were run on 2026-11-26; snippets that printed no 2027 Budapest date/venue were not opened further, and those cells are marked search_results_only_empty rather than opened-and-empty.

retained_yield_this_run (2) is the sum credited by the r7 sources ledger to the Eventbrite and Meetup lanes (the 2nd Annual Conference on Business, Economics Research & AI 2027 and Applied AI Budapest, January 2027); the Hungarian term lane added Magyar Marketing Fesztivál 2027, credited in language_lanes. ledger_yield_all_runs (14) equals stored events (14).
lane_urls_read counts the 31 URLs in the nine lanes; the Hungarian term lane's marketingfesztival.hu page is the 32nd event-lane URL read in this run.
